district_name: Colorado State Employee Assistance Program (C-SEAP), reference entry
provider: State of Colorado, Department of Personnel & Administration (C-SEAP)
who_is_covered: State of Colorado employees (executive, legislative, judicial branches), many public higher-education employees, some temporary state employees, state board members and legislators. NOT for most K-12 school district staff, who are district employees.
other_services: counseling (individual; couple/family with the state employee)
